question: Should `fanInChannelIngressLifecycles` be accepted as a supported public Plugin SDK contract for external channel plugins, or should this consolidation use a bundled/internal seam instead?
rationale: The branch deliberately expands the public Plugin SDK surface, and that choice determines the compatibility and documentation obligation for third-party plugins beyond this refactor.

options.title: Approve the public SDK helper
options.body: Accept the shared helper as a stable plugin contract, then document its terminal semantics and add real ingress proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Use an internal or bundled-only channel seam if maintainers do not want to support these lifecycle semantics for external plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve the public SDK helper
recommendation.body: Accept the shared helper as a stable plugin contract, then document its terminal semantics and add real ingress proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history identifies this person as the author of the proposed public API and channel migration; broader current-main ownership could not be verified here.
